title.narrative: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Volcanic Eruption Emergency Project

description.narrative: The Project Development Objective (PDO) is to support Saint Vincent and the Grenadines to (i) provide short-term income support, (ii) improve the capacity of the government to prepare for and respond to emergencies, and (iii) build back better critical services in the wake of the La Soufriere volcano eruption.
